text.description_html:
Acorn IKBBP, Hammered Iron Art Cabinet Door Knob

The Acorn's Iron Art Cabinet Knob is hand made. Forged in the traditional way, using a hammer and anvil, the Hammered Iron Art Cabinet Knob has a rustic look perfect for period or traditional homes. The black iron finish mimics the look of naturally weathered metal that is backed by a lifetime warranty.

For over a half a century authenticity and function have been the way Acorn Manufacturing has produced some of the highest quality forged hardware and accessories from some of New England's finest Blacksmiths for your home.

Specifications of the Hammered Iron Art Cabinet Knob:

  • Finish: Black Iron
  • Diameter: 1-1/4"
  • Projection: 1-3/8"
  • Package includes 1 knob and hardware for installation.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Sold individually. Due to the handmade craftsman nature of this product, all dimensions are approximate.
